home.here: the home page. one big red button, the date, you, and a thought of the day. touch anything you like, nothing will happen
home.greeting: that is me saying hello. a different line every day, so it does not go stale
home.reactor: the ПХ button. it says do not press. you already pressed it, i watched
home.today: date and time. the date is the same for all three of you, the clock is yours — it comes from your own machine
home.member: that is you. name, handle, and a letter instead of a face. photos when someone gets round to it
home.quote: thought of the day. one for all three of you, changes at midnight. depth not included
home.drawer: the menu on the left. five empty rows is honesty, not a bug: there are no sections yet
home.dog: i am the pug. i know everything here, mostly because there is nothing here
